run_templating_cli: run the templating script with --input-file and --output-dir to propose new crystal structures via element swapping
find_similar_elements: find elements similar to a target element by comparing ionic radii within a given tolerance
make_swap_table: build a swap table mapping each element to similar swappable elements based on ionic radius tolerance
propose_new_structures: propose new relaxed crystal structures by randomly swapping elements and relaxing with M3GNet potential
main_templating: run the main templating workflow that reads a CSV of CIFs, picks one, and generates swapped structures
